fields.why: Period-by-age and period-by-race chi-squares have the SPD as a margin, and age-specific hospitalization rates are ranked across three age groups.
Age (3 groups) and race/ethnicity (5); sex is a pair.

Composition chi-squares are omnibus under rules 2 and 6; the flagged entry is the monthly population rates by age, which carry no test (the chi-squares compare proportions between periods), so side by side is right and the flag is a false alarm.
